claim: The canonical dataset is balanced across six authors and four conditions.
The stylometric representation contains 205 features across six feature families.
Original texts have measurable authorial separability before rewriting.
Train-on-original author classification degrades on paraphrase, modernize, and simplify conditions.
Rewritten texts retain residual author separability under same-condition training.
Inter-author stylometric distances contract after rewriting.
Feature families differ in vulnerability to rewriting.
